LocalizedText.description: A player-facing text, keyed by locale. Realmforge ships English only, so en_us is the one locale.

description: A realm: its dimension, what players read about it, and the icon of its unlock.

flavour.description: A flavour line, shown on the first arrival and with the unlock: one sentence, no mechanics.

icon.description: The item the unlock advancement shows, e.g. one of the realm's blocks.
icon.title: Icon

id.description: Lowercase snake_case id; becomes realmforge:<id>. Must equal the file name.
id.title: Id

locked_hint.description: How to unlock it, shown when a player without the unlock is refused: one sentence.

name.description: The realm's name, without an article: Undervault (RLM-188).

subtitle.description: Its element, shown with the name where a player first meets it: Stone Realm (RLM-139).
